title: StakingManager `getExchangeRatio` does not handle first mint
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description `getExchangeRatio()` is supposed to be used for calculating exchange rate between HYPE and kHYPE. It checks kHYPESupply to be bigger than zero: ```solidity     function getExchangeRatio() public view returns (uint256) {         uint256 totalSlashing = validatorManager.totalSlashing();         uint256 totalRewards = validatorManager.totalRewards();         uint256 kHYPESupply = kHYPE.totalSupply();  @>      require(kHYPESupply > 0, "No kHYPE supply");          // Calculate total HYPE: totalStaked + totalRewards - totalClaim
